summary: YPF S.A. filed a 6-K furnishing its September 25, 2026 letter to the Argentine CNV, ByMA and A3 Mercados, disclosing open-market repurchases of its Class XXVII Notes (YMCTO) between September 21 and 25, 2026 for Ps. 12,092,845,940.60, equal to US$7,961,386 par, to be held in treasury. The notes were issued October 2023 at US$127,904,997 nominal and mature October 2026; average purchase price was 99.87% of par. No board recommendation, advisor or regulatory clock was stated. Watch remaining outstanding balance, future repurchases and any tender/redemption of the October 2026 maturity.
